name: Park Hyatt Aviara Resort, Golf Club & Spa
positioning: Park Hyatt resort in Carlsbad, on a bluff overlooking Batiquitos Lagoon, with an Arnold Palmer signature golf course and a Miraval spa
best_for: Golfers who want an Arnold Palmer signature course on site
Families wanting a waterslide pool and lawn games

facts.text: The resort's address is 7100 Aviara Resort Drive, Carlsbad, California.
McClellan-Palomar Airport (CLD) is 4 miles from the resort.
San Diego International Airport (SAN) is 32 miles from the resort.
The resort has covered valet parking with EV charging stations, including ChargePoint chargers for resort guests.
Miraval Life in Balance Spa Aviara debuted at the resort in 2023.
Ember & Rye, a collaboration with chef Richard Blais, is located in the Aviara Golf Club.
Ponto Lago is Baja-California inspired and serves breakfast, dinner and weekend brunch.
Pacific Point is a nod to Pacific Rim fare.
The resort has a Racquet Club with tennis and pickleball facilities.
The resort has two Topgolf Swing Suites.
A recreation center and game lawn at the Aviara Golf Club offers volleyball, a croquet field, horseshoes, a badminton court and bocce.
The hotel was originally part of the Four Seasons chain and Hyatt acquired it in 2010.

highlights.text: Aviara Golf Club has an Arnold Palmer signature golf course.
The resort is set on a bluff overlooking Batiquitos Lagoon with the Pacific Ocean in the distance.
Guests can use complimentary transportation to Aviara Golf Club, Aviara Racquet Club, Ember & Rye, Carlsbad Village and Carlsbad State Beach with advance reservation.
The family pool area has a waterslide tower.

considerations.text: The hotel is set a few miles inland from the beach in a quiet residential neighborhood.
The hotel is expansive and might not suit travelers with limited mobility.
WhataHotel notes the resort may feel large and formal for some guests.
